properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure  located a few hundred miles east of Bermuda remain disorganized.  Development of this system is becoming increasingly unlikely as it  drifts westward over the subtropical Atlantic during the next day or  so. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.

Disorganized showers and thunderstorms associated with a tropical  wave are located several hundred miles south-southwest of  southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions remain conducive for  gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression is  likely to form late this weekend or early next week while it moves  gradually northwestward and then northward off the coast of  southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low  pressure located well southwest of the southern tip of the Baja  California Peninsula remain disorganized. Environmental conditions  appear conducive for additional development of this system, and a  tropical depression is likely to form this weekend as it moves  westward at 10 to 15 mph across the western East Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of Tropical  Depression Fifteen-E remain limited. Environmental conditions appear  conducive for some development of this system as it moves gradually  westward to west-southwestward, remaining well east-southeast to  southeast of the Hawaiian Islands.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.
